essence: Daily devotion is rightly directed to Rama accompanied by Sita and Lakshmana.
Devotion to Rama brings a Shiva-pervaded world and readily serving powers.
Daily recitation produces devotion to Rama.
This teaching is the highest secret in the three worlds.
The scene is set for Shankara to speak to Parvati before eating.
